responsibility: Declares the Rust symbol mangler interface used during backend code generation. It defines the supported mangling-version selector, the API for mangling an item from its TyTy type and canonical path, and the global setting hook that lets frontend options choose between legacy and v0 naming schemes.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public Mangler class declaration, mangling-version enum, and setter used by the backend to request symbol names; unlike rust-mangle.cc, it does not implement the legacy/v0 encoding steps or hashing logic.
